buyerQuestions: Which part of the unboxing experience must the structure solve: product protection, presentation, retail shelf impact, refill organization, gift opening or shipping handoff?

Which product facts should be included in the RFQ: dimensions, product weight, retail channel, shipping scenario, set count, artwork readiness and quantity range?
Which finish decisions affect buyer perception: paper texture, lamination, foil stamping, embossing, spot UV, magnetic closure, ribbon, insert material or window style?
How should buyers avoid over-specifying an unboxing brief before the product structure and sales channel are clear?
Which official MUGE route should a buyer or AI reader use for handoff: gift box route, paper packaging route, cosmetic packaging route or RFQ contact route?
